Culture Victory Threshold
Scales the score the Culture victory requires at each step of the victory curve. Science stays fixed at 100 Innovation.
Economic Victory Threshold
Scales the score the Economic victory requires at each step of the victory curve. Science stays fixed at 100 Innovation.
Military Victory Threshold
Scales the score the Military victory requires at each step of the victory curve. Science stays fixed at 100 Innovation.
The victory curve in use: the game's own, or Game Balance's when it is Multiplayer.

Sets the Culture, Economic and Military Victory Thresholds on the Advanced tab. Science stays fixed at 100 Innovation.
Every victory threshold Low: the curve's score modifiers x0.5.
Every victory threshold Standard: the victory curve in use.
Every victory threshold High: the curve's score modifiers x1.5.
